metadata.prompt:
A clean 2x3 six-view character fashion reference asset board. The character is @图片1: a young woman approximately 18-22 years old, with long wavy dark brown hair, fair skin, natural facial features — preserve her exact face shape, eye spacing, nose, lips, and age impression. Do not slim, elongate, or reshape her body; keep her natural head-to-body ratio, shoulder width, torso proportion, and limb length. She is wearing the outfit from @图片2: a red short cropped T-shirt with a heart/star graphic print on the front, paired with oversized wide-leg yellow cargo-style pants with drawstring waist and large front pockets, and red shoes. Do not inherit the clothing model's body shape.

Fixed 2x3 layout:
Top-left: front face close-up — clear face, five features, wavy dark brown hair, fair skin, natural expression
Top-center: 45-degree face close-up — same person, consistent face structure, hair, skin
Top-right: footwear close-up — the red shoes detail
Bottom-left: full-body front view — complete figure head to toe, natural standing pose, red cropped T-shirt with heart/star print, yellow wide-leg cargo pants, red shoes, arms relaxed at sides
Bottom-center: full-body side view — 90-degree side, body thickness, outfit silhouette side profile
Bottom-right: full-body back view — back of head and hair, back of outfit, back of pants, shoes from behind

Background: neutral clean light studio background, even soft lighting, true garment colors (red T-shirt, yellow pants, red shoes), no scene, no props, no text overlays. Photorealistic, reference-board presentation, consistent color management across all six cells.

nodes.title: 女装展示视频宣传海报

metadata.prompt:
一张竖版时尚宣传海报，主视觉参考 @图片1 中的人物形象：18-22岁年轻女性，深棕色长波浪发，白皙肤色，穿着红色爱心图案短款T恤搭配明黄色宽腿工装裤和红色鞋，站在福建东山岛海边，蓝天大海背景，夏日阳光明媚，海风轻拂，宽腿裤随风飘动，人物姿态自然放松，全身展示穿搭，画面明亮清新，有旅行短视频质感。

海报设计：
- 顶部留白区域放标题文字
- 主标题大字：「女装一键生成15/30秒展示视频」，现代简洁字体，白色或亮色，带轻微阴影增强可读性
- 副标题小字：「上传人物 × 选择服装 → 即刻成片」
- 底部加品牌标识区域
- 整体风格：时尚、明亮、科技感与时装感结合，夏日活力色调（红、黄、蓝天白云）
- 16：9比例

nodes.title: 东山岛旅游服装展示视频

metadata.prompt:
Create exactly one complete 15-second R2V video in a single generation task. All timing beats and camera changes belong to this same continuous video. Do not create separate clips, storyboard frames, anchor images, keyframes, or an editing workflow.

The character reference is @图片1: a young woman, approximately 18-22 years old, with long wavy dark brown hair, fair skin, natural facial features. Strictly maintain her exact face shape, hair, skin tone, age impression, natural body proportions (head-to-body ratio, shoulder width, torso, limbs) throughout the entire video. Do not slim, elongate, or reshape her body. Do not model-ize her figure.

She is wearing: a red short cropped T-shirt with a heart and star graphic print on the front, paired with oversized wide-leg yellow cargo-style pants with drawstring waist and large front pockets, and red shoes. Maintain the exact outfit — red T-shirt with print, yellow wide-leg pants, red shoes — throughout the entire video. Do not change garment color, structure, pattern, or footwear at any point.

Scene: Dongshan Island (东山岛), Zhangzhou, Fujian — a coastal tourist destination with golden sandy beaches, blue sea, coastal rocks, and bright summer light. Natural outdoor daylight, warm and vibrant summer atmosphere.

Internal director rhythm (all within this single 15-second video):
0:00–0:02 — Establish: full-body front view of the character standing on the beach or coastal path, the complete outfit clearly visible against the sea backdrop, bright natural light.
0:02–0:05 — Character walks naturally along the shoreline or on coastal rocks, wide-leg pants flowing gently in the sea breeze, full-body shot showing outfit silhouette and fabric movement.
0:05–0:08 — Camera follows at a natural medium distance, character moves forward, the yellow pants fabric and red T-shirt print visible in natural light; slight side view showing outfit structure.
0:08–0:11 — Visual highlight: character turns her head back toward camera with a natural smile, the sea and coastline behind her, outfit front clearly visible; camera gently pushes in to medium shot.
0:11–0:13 — Character naturally stops near the water's edge or on a coastal viewpoint, looking out at the sea; half-body or medium shot showing outfit detail.
0:13–0:15 — Natural ending: character stands relaxed, looking at the horizon, gentle sea breeze, natural close to the scene.

Style: bright, fresh, lively summer travel short video aesthetic. Stable camera movement — slow follow, gentle push-in, natural handheld. No extreme angles, no fast spinning, no heavy effects. Person and outfit stability always take priority over complex movements or cinematic tricks. No subtitles. No BGM
